lead.titleZh: 膝关节置换术物理治疗管理临床实践指南 2026 版
lead.titleEn: Clinical Practice Guideline for TKA Physical Therapy 2026 Revision
lead.paragraphZh: 今日共 4 条更新，覆盖骨科与肌骨以及行业与执业两个领域。最值得关注的是膝关节置换术物理治疗管理临床实践指南的 2026 年修订版，curatedScore 达 88 分。此外，有 1 条观察研究探讨中国长期护理保险试点与老年人护理缺口。
lead.paragraphEn: Today's update includes 4 items across two specialties: orthopedics and musculoskeletal, and industry and practice. The most notable update is the 2026 revision of the clinical practice guideline for physical therapist management of total knee arthroplasty, scoring 88. Additionally, one observational study examines long-term care insurance pilots and care gaps among older adults in China.

items.title: Clinical practice guideline for physical therapist management of total knee arthroplasty: revision 2026.
items.summary: The American Physical Therapy Association is updating its clinical practice guideline for total knee arthroplasty, with the revision scheduled for 2026. This guideline, developed by a multidisciplinary group and based on a systematic review, includes 20 recommendations addressing benefits, harms, feasibility, and patient preferences.
items.curatedReason: 美国物理治疗协会（APTA）的这份膝关节置换术（TKA）临床实践指南，修订版定于 2026 年发布，基于系统综述，提出了 20 项建议。关注它能帮你确保 TKA 术后康复方案与最新循证实践对齐。
items.titleZh: 膝关节置换术物理治疗管理临床实践指南：2026 年修订版
items.summaryZh: 美国物理治疗协会（APTA）正在修订其膝关节置换术（TKA）临床实践指南，预计 2026 年发布。该指南由多学科小组基于系统综述制定，包含 20 项涵盖益处、风险、可行性和患者偏好的建议。
items.curatedReasonEn: This updated clinical practice guideline from APTA for total knee arthroplasty (TKA), set for revision in 2026, offers 20 recommendations based on a systematic review. Monitor this to ensure your TKA post-operative rehab protocols align with the latest evidence-based practices.

items.title: 国家中医药局、国家发展改革委负责同志就《中医药振兴发展“十五五”规划》答记者问-健康界
items.summary: China's "15th Five-Year Plan" for Traditional Chinese Medicine (TCM) revitalization and development emphasizes enhancing TCM rehabilitation and nursing service capabilities, aiming to achieve universal access to TCM services and improve disease prevention and health promotion.
items.curatedReason: 《中医药振兴发展“十五五”规划》强调提升中医药康复护理服务能力。这表明中国将持续加大对中医药康复的支持，你应关注政策落地，探索中西医结合康复的新模式和新机遇。
items.titleZh: 国家中医药局、国家发展改革委负责同志就《中医药振兴发展“十五五”规划》答记者问
items.summaryZh: 中国《中医药振兴发展“十五五”规划》强调提升中医药康复护理服务能力，旨在实现人人享有中医药服务，并加强疾病预防和健康促进。
items.curatedReasonEn: The "15th Five-Year Plan" for Traditional Chinese Medicine (TCM) revitalization and development emphasizes enhancing TCM rehabilitation and nursing service capabilities. This indicates China will continue to increase support for TCM rehabilitation, and you should monitor policy implementation to explore new models and opportunities for integrated TCM and Western rehabilitation.

items.title: Long-term care insurance pilots and a severe care-gap proxy among older adults in China: evidence from CHARLS, 2011–2020 | BMC Geriatrics
items.summary: A research study from China, using CHARLS 2011–2020 data, investigated whether long-term care insurance pilots reduced a severe care-gap proxy among older adults, noting limited evidence on policy rollout reducing care gaps.
items.curatedReason: 这项来自中国的观察性研究表明，长期护理保险试点项目可能有助于减少功能受限老年人的护理缺口。作为康复专业人员，了解并积极参与这些政策的实施，对改善老年患者的康复可及性和长期照护至关重要。
items.titleZh: 中国长期护理保险试点与老年人严重护理缺口：CHARLS 2011–2020 证据
items.summaryZh: 一项来自中国的研究，利用 CHARLS 2011-2020 数据，调查了长期护理保险试点项目是否减少了老年人严重的护理缺口，指出政策实施对减少护理缺口的影响证据有限。
items.curatedReasonEn: This observational study from China suggests that long-term care insurance pilot programs may help reduce care gaps for functionally limited older adults. As a rehab professional, understanding and actively engaging with these policy implementations is crucial for improving older patients' access to rehabilitation and long-term care.
items.limitation: 这是一项来自中国的研究，其政策背景和医疗系统特点可能限制了结果对外推到其他国家或地区。
items.limitationEn: This study from China, with its specific policy background and healthcare system, may have limited generalizability to other countries or regions.

items.title: Saratoga Physical Therapy Associates Increases Payment Per Visit by $5 using WebPT RCM
items.summary: Saratoga Physical Therapy Associates increased their payment per visit by $5 after implementing WebPT RCM, demonstrating the financial benefits of optimized revenue cycle management for physical therapy practices.
items.curatedReason: WebPT 的这个案例提示我们，RCM 优化能直接提升诊所营收。如果你还没细看过自家的每诊次支付额，现在是时候审视你的 RCM 流程了，别白白损失了这每诊次多出的几美元。
items.titleZh: Saratoga 物理治疗协会使用 WebPT RCM 后每诊次支付增加 5 美元
items.summaryZh: Saratoga 物理治疗协会在使用 WebPT 的收入周期管理（RCM）系统后，成功将其每诊次的支付额提高了 5 美元。
items.curatedReasonEn: This WebPT case study suggests that RCM optimization can directly boost clinic revenue. If you haven't recently scrutinized your payment per visit, it's time to audit your RCM processes; don't leave those extra few dollars per visit on the table.
